Fix the following error: 
 Undefined control sequence.

l.82 \chemfig
             {
The control sequence at the end of the top line
of your error message was never \def'ed. If you have
misspelled it (e.g., `\hobx'), type `I' and the correct
spelling (e.g., `I\hbox'). Otherwise just continue,
and I'll forget about whatever was undefined.
I’ll inspect the LaTeX source around line 82 and the document preamble, then add the missing chemistry package or adjust the command and compile to verify.

The `chemfig` package is installed, but the source never loads it. I found the failing command in `present.tex`; I’m adding the package to that document’s preamble and will run XeLaTeX to catch any follow-on syntax issues.

Fixed in `present.tex` by adding:

```latex
\usepackage{chemfig}
```

Verified with XeLaTeX; `present.pdf` now compiles successfully.

Fix the following error: 
 Missing \endcsname inserted.

<to be read again> 
                   \protect 
l.122 \end
          {question}
The control sequence marked <to be read again> should
not appear between \csname and \endcsname.

I’ll inspect the active source around line 122 and compile it to trace the malformed command earlier in the `question` environment; errors reported at `\end{question}` are often triggered several lines above.

The closing line is only where the captured `question` body is expanded. I’m narrowing the fault within that body and checking the class’s expected syntax before editing, since the environment itself is balanced.

The trace identifies the exact cause: TikZ is interpreting the quoted angle label as a key because the `quotes` library is not loaded. The `angle` pic also requires the `angles` library, so I’m enabling both alongside `calc`.

Fixed `present.tex` by loading the required TikZ libraries:

```latex
\usetikzlibrary{calc,angles,quotes}
```

XeLaTeX now compiles successfully and generates `present.pdf`.

Fix the following error: 
No PDF Created

Does your document contain content? Or maybe bibtex failed?
I’ll compile the current LaTeX entry files and inspect the newest logs. “No PDF Created” is only a wrapper message, so the underlying TeX error should appear earlier in the log.

The actual failure is `Not allowed in LR mode`: `exam-zh` measures each choice inside an `\hbox`, but every graphical choice contains a `center` environment, which starts paragraph/list mode. I’m removing those incompatible wrappers; the TikZ pictures themselves remain valid choice content.

Fixed `present.tex`. The graphical choices contained `center` environments incompatible with `exam-zh` choice measurement.

Removed those wrappers and verified twice with XeLaTeX. `present.pdf` now builds successfully with 3 pages.
